THE COUNT OF Examination [has ExaminationThrombosis: '2'] [has ExaminationANAPattern: 'S'] [has ExaminationACLIgM m] WHERE m > (THE AVERAGE Examination has ExaminationACLIgM) * 1.2

THE COUNT OF Patient [has PatientSEX: 'F'] [has PatientDescription de] [has PatientAdmission: '-'] WHERE year(de) = 1997
